boundary.evidence: self-contained CLI gate in the skill's scripts/; single owner of the template field list

ownership.evidence: REQUIRED_FIELDS + CITATION are the one source; no duplication

error-handling.evidence: die exit 2 on usage/IO/zero-entries; exit 1 on gaps; fence-aware, content-required, non-wiki citation

ownership.evidence: template + record are the single source; wired into always-on + enterprise-architecture-standards

error-handling.evidence: evidence section + honest limits; provenance claim corrected to match citations

findings.title: gate accepted EMPTY fields (label present, no content) -> false pass
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: a half-filled entry could ship despite the 'fully templated' claim
findings.evidence: reviewer RUN: all 15 labels present but empty values -> OK exit 0
findings.resolution: rewrote gate fence-aware + require real content after each label (same line or following block before the next field); empty-field test added

findings.title: SKILL.md claimed 'primary and peer-reviewed only, no Wikipedia' but 2 entries cite a blog / library docs
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: the skill's headline honesty claim was false against its own catalog (Result/Either -> Wlaschin blog; Lens -> hackage docs)
findings.resolution: softened the claim to the truth (primary where one exists; newer patterns cite the originating author's write-up / reference impl); also made the gate REJECT wikipedia.org so 'no Wikipedia' is enforced, not just stated

findings.title: citation check non-discriminating: any URL, or a bare (1994) year, passed
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a year or a Wikipedia URL counted as a primary-source citation
findings.evidence: reviewer RUN: 'see the book (1994)' passed; a wikipedia URL passed
findings.resolution: CITATION now excludes wikipedia.org and drops the bare parenthesized-number alt (keeps (p. NNN)); bare-year + wikipedia-only tests added

findings.title: test covered only 6 of 15 fields (9 field checks could be deleted undetected)
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: the gate's detection of 9 fields was unproven; 'discriminating-tested' was a partial overclaim
findings.evidence: reviewer mutation: deleting the Pros check left the suite green
findings.resolution: per-field FAILS test now loops over all 15 REQUIRED_FIELDS

findings.title: entry splitter + field scan were fence-blind (### or Label: inside an Example fence mis-parsed)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: a label inside a code fence could satisfy a real field (false pass); a ### inside a fence made a spurious entry (false fail)
findings.evidence: reviewer RUN: fields only inside a fence -> entry passed; nested ### in fence -> spurious entry
findings.resolution: gate now tracks a per-line fence mask; splits entries and finds labels only outside fences, while fence CONTENT still counts for the Example field; fenced-code test added

findings.title: README said 'twelve engineering-standards' but there are 13 top-level skills
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: wrong sub-count; enumeration collapsed the two testing skills into one word
findings.evidence: reviewer: 13 dirs with SKILL.md; README:16 said twelve
findings.resolution: changed to thirteen and listed BDD + test strategy separately

verdict: 6 findings (2 high, 3 med, 1 low), all fixed with tests; gate rewritten fence-aware + content-required; provenance claim corrected
